text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Financial Procedure) (Amendment) Order, 2016 and shall be deemed to have commenced on 1st April Amendment of section 13 of Constitution I11

Section 13 of the Constitution (Financial Procedure) Order is amended by repealing subsections (2) and (3) and by substituting the following two new subsections therefor - "(2) There shall be laid before the Legislative Council a list showing under each head of expenditure the categories of activities which expenditure are to be met from the Consolidated Fund and the amount to be paid in respect of them.

(3) Except in accordance with any written law, no addition or alteration to the list referred to in subsection (2) shall be made unless the prior approval of the Treasury has been obtained.". Made this 12th. day of Zulkaedah, 1437 Hijriah corresponding to the 15th. day of August, 2016 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM
